# Psalm 106 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 106:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Remember-me O-YHWH in-favor-of your-people; visit-me with-your-salvation,
- **LOGOS:** Remember me, O LORD, when you show favor to your people; help me when you save them,
- **PNEUMA:** Remember me, LORD, when you bless your people! Come to my rescue when you save them!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 106:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** To-see in-goodness-of your-chosen-ones, to-rejoice in-gladness-of your-nation, to-boast with-your-inheritance.
- **LOGOS:** that I may look upon the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
- **PNEUMA:** Let me share in the prosperity of your chosen people, celebrate with your nation, and join your people in praising you.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 106:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** We-have-sinned with-our-fathers; we-have-committed-iniquity; we-have-acted-wickedly.
- **LOGOS:** Both we and our fathers have sinned; we have committed iniquity; we have done wickedness.
- **PNEUMA:** We have sinned, just like our ancestors. We have done wrong. We have acted wickedly.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 106:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Our-fathers in-Egypt not understood your-wonders; not they-remembered the-abundance-of your-steadfast-love; and-they-rebelled at-the-sea, at-the-Sea-of Reeds.
- **LOGOS:** Our fathers, when they were in Egypt, did not consider your wondrous works; they did not remember the abundance of your steadfast love, but rebelled by the sea, at the Red Sea.
- **PNEUMA:** When our ancestors were in Egypt, they didn't appreciate your miracles. They forgot how often you showed them love. They rebelled right there at the Red Sea.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 106:8 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-he-saved-them for-sake-of his-name, to-make-known his-might.
- **LOGOS:** Yet he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make known his mighty power.
- **PNEUMA:** But he saved them anyway — to defend the honor of his name and demonstrate his power.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 106:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-he-rebuked the-Sea-of Reeds and-it-dried-up; and-he-led-them through-the-depths as-through-the-wilderness.
- **LOGOS:** He rebuked the Red Sea, and it became dry, and he led them through the deep as through a desert.
- **PNEUMA:** He commanded the Red Sea and it dried up. He walked them through the deep ocean floor as easily as through a desert.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
